01 / THE ORDERFIVE DONORS

THE ORDER OF THE CUTS

Five pieces were selected for the same body. The surgeon described them without using their names. Find the five matching drawings and enter their two-digit file numbers in order.

  1. FIRST

    What reaches even after the arm is gone.

  2. SECOND

    The voice raised on a throat too long to survive.

  3. THIRD

    What remains above the floor after the rope is cut.

  4. FOURTH

    The face that denies its curse, even with the mark still in its eye.

  5. FIFTH

    The thing that the earth could not keep.

THE BODY IS STILL IN PIECES.

TEAR OPEN THE FIRST ENVELOPE / HINT

Every line points to a distinct physical feature in one of the scanned drawings. The answers are their FILE numbers, not page positions. The fourth drawing was labelled by its creator.

02 / THE DEPTHFIVE RECORDS

READ BELOW THE SKIN

The correct five are now sewn together. Every one has an INCISION DEPTH and an EXAMINATION in its file. Each depth tells you how many words in to cut. Take one word from each examination in the same order you recovered the donors.

THE WORDS WILL TELL YOU WHAT TO DO NEXT.

THE EXAMINATIONS ARE WAITING.

TEAR OPEN THE SECOND ENVELOPE / HINT

For example, a depth of 04 means the fourth word of an examination. Don't use the depositions yet. The five extracted words form a single instruction.

03 / THE NAMEFINAL EXAMINATION

IT HAS BEEN TRYING
TO TELL YOU ITS NAME.

Obey the instruction you recovered. Keep your five donors in order. Their DEPOSITIONS have always been there, alongside the drawings.

ONE WORD. FIVE LETTERS. NO SPACES IN THE BODY.

THE LAST WORDS ARE NEVER THE LAST WORDS.

TEAR OPEN THE THIRD ENVELOPE / HINT

Each deposition ends in one last word. You need the first letter of each of those last words. Read them in donor order, not the order they appeared on the page.

THE FILE HAS OPENED.

THE NAME WAS WOUND.

YOU HAVE FOUND THE SOURCE.

The archive ends here. The signal continues elsewhere.
